appliedUpdates.description: Added .factory/library/testing-quirks.md to document that safe-json returns null-prototype objects which break assert.deepStrictEqual.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update mission-worker-base and compliance-fix-worker to provide explicit guidance on handling baseline validation (e.g., pnpm test) when the codebase is known to be in a broken state for the current milestone. Multiple workers bypassed full suites in favor of targeted tests.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Observed in features fix-agent-skill-matrix-and-read-safety, fix-lint-warnings, and fix-routing-overlap-and-ghost-agent.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Provide guidance on using git commit --no-verify when repo-wide pre-commit hooks fail due to unrelated staged files left by previous workers.
Ensure feature descriptions do not contain constraints that conflict with their expectedBehavior fields (e.g., 'Do NOT run pnpm test' vs 'pnpm test exits 0').

rejectedObservations.observation: Worker skipped commit step because fix was already present.
Working tree contained many unrelated modified files.
